description: Source code for network memory management and diagnostic commands in Zephyr OS, including functions to gather and print network buffer and context memory usage.

methods.name: slab_pool_found_already
methods.description: Checks if a slab or pool has already been encountered in context info to avoid duplicates.

methods.name: context_info
methods.description: Gathers information about network contexts' memory pools and slabs, updating context info structure.

methods.name: cmd_net_mem
methods.description: Command handler that prints network memory usage details, including buffer pools and context info.
